english.note: Use 私處 specifically for the private parts when “shame” refers to the body rather than to modesty or emotion.

examples.english: The doctor said there was no need to feel shame about problems with your private parts.
examples.traditional: 醫生話私處有問題，唔使覺得羞恥。
